settings.store: SqliteMemoryStore(':memory:'), one per question, shared by its arms
settings.recall: HybridRetriever.recall(question, { limit: 100 }), a fresh retriever per arm
settings.armOrder: rotates by one arm per question
settings.recallTiming: per question and arm, the wall-clock and CPU time of the HybridRetriever.recall call alone (query embedding, keyword and vector search, fusion and any reranking), one recall at a time
